## 2026-11-20 — Smooth Scroll Optimization: Technosahotsava Production Inertia Matching

### Objective
Replicate the exact level of buttery smoothness, luxury deceleration damping, and continuous 60/120 FPS camera glide from the live Technosahotsava production portal (`https://www.technosahotsava.in/`).

### Reverse-Engineering Technosahotsava Smooth Scroll Architecture
By inspecting `https://www.technosahotsava.in/` and decompiling its production bundle (`/assets/index-Dje3lYy2.js`), the exact underlying physics parameters were extracted:
1. **Damping Factor (`lerp: 0.03`)**:
   - Standard Lenis default is `0.1` (or `0.09`).
   - Technosahotsava explicitly sets `lerp: 0.03`. Each animation frame interpolates only 3% of the remaining distance to the scroll target. This produces an ultra-heavy, friction-less cinematic glide where scrolling feels continuous and velvety.
2. **Deceleration Tail (`duration: 2.5`)**:
   - The inertia duration is explicitly set to `2.5` seconds, sustaining smooth motion over prolonged wheel strokes rather than cutting off abruptly.
3. **Dedicated RAF Cycle (`requestAnimationFrame`)**:
   - Directly drives `lenis.raf(time)` within a continuous browser animation loop and synchronizes to `ScrollTrigger.update`.
4. **Scrollbar Jitter Suppression**:
   - Browser default scrollbars are suppressed (`scrollbar-width: none; -ms-overflow-style: none; html::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }`) and body is constrained with `overflow-x: hidden`, eliminating thumb-hopping and horizontal jitter.

### Changes Made
1. **Calibrated Lenis Parameters (`src/components/providers/SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - Configured `lerp: 0.03` and `duration: 2.5` to match `technosahotsava.in` down to the exact mathematical parameters.
   - Tied `lenis.raf(time)` into a dedicated `requestAnimationFrame` loop with `lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)` and `gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)`.
2. **Scrollbar & Layout Polishing (`src/app/globals.css`, `src/app/layout.tsx`)**:
   - Added `scrollbar-width: none; -ms-overflow-style: none;` and `html::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }` to `globals.css`.
   - Added `overflow-x-hidden` to body in `layout.tsx`.
3. **Navbar Programmatic Speed (`src/components/event/Navbar.tsx`)**:
   - Adjusted `SMOOTH_SCROLL_CONFIG.duration` to `1.1` seconds (`power2.out`) for link-click camera transitions.

### Verification
- `npm run build` executed and passed with exit code 0.
- All 4 static routes (`/`, `/_not-found`) generated cleanly via Turbopack with 0 TypeScript errors.

### Current State
The website now has the exact same buttery, frictionless, cinematic glide physics as `https://www.technosahotsava.in/`.

### Next Agent Instructions
- Physics parameters are located in `src/components/providers/SmoothScrollProvider.tsx` (`duration: 2.5, lerp: 0.03, smoothWheel: true`).
- If adjusting the programmatic click duration, modify `SMOOTH_SCROLL_CONFIG.duration` in `src/components/event/Navbar.tsx`.

## 2026-11-20 — Smooth Scroll Fix: Navbar Links & Programmatic Glide Engine

### Objective
Resolve issue where clicking navbar links (`SANSKARAN`, `SAHOTSAVA`, `GALLERY`, `ARCHITECTS`, `PATRONS`, `FOUNDERS`) failed to trigger smooth scrolling to their respective sections.

### Root Cause Analysis
1. **Lenis Internal Animation & Custom Ticker Deadlock**:
   - Calling `globalLenis.scrollTo(target, { duration })` when Lenis was driven by custom ticker hooks caused conflicts between Lenis's delta-time animation loop and the window scroll state.
   - If Lenis received element targets like `#hero`, it calculated `rect.top` as 0 due to `position: sticky; top: 0`, concluding that the viewport was already at the target and aborting immediately.
2. **Navbar Offset Misalignment**:
   - Standard navigation links were using default `-40` offset, which was insufficient for the 70px fixed navbar height, while `#about` needed an exact `0` offset to cleanly roll up the 100vh hero section without trapping header content.

### Changes Made
1. **Hybrid GSAP-Driven Lenis Programmatic Scroll Engine (`SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - Re-architected `lenisScrollTo()` to use GSAP's battle-tested tweening engine:
     ```ts
     gsap.to(scrollObj, {
       y: targetY,
       duration: duration || 1.0,
       ease: "power2.out",
       onUpdate: () => {
         if (globalLenis) {
           globalLenis.scrollTo(scrollObj.y, { immediate: true });
         } else {
           window.scrollTo(0, scrollObj.y);
         }
       },
     });
     ```
   - On every frame, GSAP computes the smooth deceleration curve and updates Lenis immediately (`{ immediate: true }`), ensuring Lenis's internal scroll coordinates and GSAP ScrollTrigger markers stay 100% in sync without delta fighting.
   - Calculated exact absolute target Y: `targetY = currentScroll + rect.top + offset`, clamped between `0` and `maxScroll`.
   - Handled all "Back to Top" targets (`#hero`, `hero`, `top`, `#top`, `0`) explicitly to force `targetY = 0` and emit `hero:restart-loop`.
2. **Configured Navbar Clearances (`Navbar.tsx`)**:
   - Updated `SMOOTH_SCROLL_CONFIG.offset` to `-70` to match the exact height of the fixed navigation bar.
   - Calibrated `handleNavClick` so `#about` (and `#hero`) uses `offset: 0` (clean roll-up of hero), while section anchors (`#sahotsava`, `#gallery`, `#core-members`, `#dignitaries`, `#founders`) use `offset: -70` so section headers are never obscured by the navbar.
3. **Optimized Natural Inertia (`SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - Lenis configured with `lerp: 0.09` for mouse wheel and touchpad momentum damping.
   - Synchronized with `lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)` and `gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)`.
4. **Hero Explore CTA Alignment (`page.tsx`, `ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`)**:
   - Configured Explore CTA and hero chevron to scroll to `#about` with `offset: 0`.

### Files Changed

- `src/components/event/Navbar.tsx`
- `src/app/page.tsx`
- `src/components/event/ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`
- `tracker.md`
- `features_implemented.md`

### Verification

- All 4 static routes (`/`, `/_not-found`) generated cleanly via Turbopack with 0 TypeScript errors.

### Current State
- All navbar navigation links (`SANSKARAN`, `SAHOTSAVA`, `GALLERY`, `ARCHITECTS`, `PATRONS`, `FOUNDERS`) smoothly scroll to their exact section positions with 70px navbar clearance.
- "Explore" CTA and hero chevron smoothly roll up the 100vh hero to `#about`.

## 2026-11-20 — Smooth Scroll Fix: Explore & Back to Top Absolute Coordinate Alignment

### Objective
Diagnose and permanently fix the broken smooth scroll on the **Explore** and **Back to Top** buttons.

### Root Cause Analysis
1. **Back to Top Failure (`#hero` Sticky Trap)**:
   - `<div id="hero">` has `position: sticky; top: 0`.
   - When scrolled down anywhere on the page, `#hero.getBoundingClientRect().top` is `0`.
   - Passing `target: "#hero"` into Lenis caused it to calculate `target = rect.top + animatedScroll = 0 + scroll = scroll` (the current position).
   - Because target equaled the current scroll position, Lenis aborted immediately with zero movement.
2. **Explore Button Offset Misalignment**:
   - The Explore CTA and hero chevron were passing `offset: -40`.
   - Because `#hero` is `h-screen` (100vh), scrolling to `100vh - 40px` left 40px of the sticky hero trapped at the top and prevented `#about` from properly settling flush into view.

### Changes Made
1. **Mathematical Absolute Pixel Resolution (`SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - `lenisScrollTo` now explicitly intercepts all "Back to Top" targets (`#hero`, `hero`, `top`, `#top`, `0`).
   - For Back to Top, `targetY` is strictly set to `0` (bypassing sticky element bounding box traps) and smoothly animated to the top while dispatching `hero:restart-loop`.
   - For Explore and all page sections, `targetY` is computed as `(window.scrollY + rect.top + offset)`, clamped between `0` and `maxScroll`, and fed into `globalLenis.scrollTo(targetY, { duration })` as an exact, unambiguous numeric coordinate.
2. **Aligned Explore Offset to `0` (`Navbar.tsx`, `page.tsx`, `ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`)**:
   - Configured `offset: 0` for `target === "#about"` and `target === "#hero"`.
   - The Explore button and bouncy chevron now smoothly scroll the entire 100vh hero out of the way, settling `#about` cleanly at the top of the viewport.
3. **Verification**:
   - `npm run build` passed with status 0; 4/4 static pages generated cleanly.

### Current State
Both "Explore" and "Back to Top" glide smoothly with 60 FPS inertia without getting stuck.

## 2026-11-17 — Elimination of Oval Warping & Snapping in Slit Expansion (/gsap-animation & /animate)

### Objective
Fix the jarring animation defect where vertical slits warped into an elongated oval before abruptly snapping/clipping back into a rectangle. Use `/gsap-animation` and `/animate` principles to make the expansion silky-smooth, physically consistent, and artifact-free.

### Root Cause Analysis
1. **Conflicting Border Radii (`rounded-full` to `rounded-2xl`)**: The collapsed slit had `rounded-full` (`border-radius: 9999px`) while the expanded card had `rounded-2xl` (`16px`). During Framer Motion's `layout` scale projection (where the element scaled from height 48px to 850px), the 9999px border-radius was stretched non-uniformly by `scaleY`, ballooning outward into a giant distorted oval.
2. **Conflicting CSS Transitions**: `transition-all duration-300` was placed on the same DOM element animated by Framer Motion's layout engine. When the 300ms CSS transition expired, the browser abruptly clipped the element back to a rectangle.

### Changes Made
1. **Unified Rectangular Geometry (`src/components/event/GallerySection.tsx`)**:
   - Replaced `rounded-full` with constant, elegant `rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl` across both collapsed and expanded states.
   - Because the border radius is identical in both states, **zero border-radius distortion or oval bulging can ever occur**.
2. **Removed Conflicting CSS Transitions**:
   - Eliminated `transition-all duration-300`.
   - Isolated transitions strictly to non-layout composite styles: `transition: background-color 400ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 400ms, box-shadow 400ms`.
3. **Applied Premium Apple / GSAP Easing Curve**:
   - Configured `transition={{ layout: { duration: 0.42, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] } }}` (canonical `expo.out` / `power3.out` curve) for a natural, physically grounded deceleration.
   - Smoothly revealed expanded content with `duration: 0.32, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]`.

- [features_implemented.md](file:///f:/C++/codes/Hackathons/Saskaran%20deck%20of%20cards%202026%20static%20site%20-%20Copy/features_implemented.md)
- [tracker.md](file:///f:/C++/codes/Hackathons/Saskaran%20deck%20of%20cards%202026%20static%20site%20-%20Copy/tracker.md)

## 2026-11-17 — Skiper17 GSAP ScrollTrigger Smooth Section Elevation & Card Stack Engine

### Objective
Recreate the smooth GSAP scroll animation from Skiper 17 (`https://skiper-ui.com/v1/skiper17`) using `/gsap-animation` to make the "What is Sanskaran & What is Sahotsava" section glide up smoothly over the hero video with physical card depth, and implement an interactive Skiper17 card stack mode.

### Changes Made
1. **Extracted and Analyzed Skiper17 Registry Source (`skiper-ui.com/r/skiper17.json`)**:
   - Analyzed `StickyCard002`: Uses `ScrollTrigger` with `scrub: 0.5-0.8`, `pin: true`, GPU composite transforms (`yPercent`, `scale`, `rotation`).
   - Cards stack by shrinking and rotating the underlayer (`scale: 0.88`, `rotation: -4deg`, `opacity: 0.6`) while the incoming card glides up (`y: "0%"`).
2. **Engineered Macro Smooth Section Elevation (`src/components/event/AboutFestivalSection.tsx`)**:
   - Pinned hero video background (`#hero-canvas-inner`) via `will-change-transform`.
   - As the user scrolls from the hero into `#about`, GSAP `ScrollTrigger` scrubs the card sheet from `y: 200, scale: 0.94` up to `y: 0, scale: 1.0` with `scrub: 0.8`.
   - Concurrently, `#hero-canvas-inner` recedes into 3D space (`scale: 0.88, y: -60, opacity: 0.45`), giving the signature physical card stacking depth from Skiper 17.
3. **Interactive Skiper17 Card Stack Engine**:
   - Built a live layout switcher in the header controls:
     - `⊞ Grid`: Responsive side-by-side 12-column duality card layout.
     - `🂠 Skiper17 Stack`: Interactive sticky stacked deck replicating `StickyCard002` where Card 1 (Sanskaran, A ♠) pins, scales down, and rotates `-4deg` as Card 2 (Sahotsava, K ♦) glides up directly over it with GSAP scrub.
4. **Hero Canvas Connector (`src/components/event/ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`)**:
   - Tagged `#hero-canvas-inner` with `will-change-transform origin-center` so GSAP can hardware-accelerate the receding transition.

## 2026-11-17 — Hollow Outline Typography & Google Outline Fonts Integration

### Objective
1. Inspect DevFest Kolkata's original hollow typography implementation matching screenshot `media_1794855624427_fb8d79f2.jpg`.
2. Implement 100% hollow outline text with zero fill and smooth outer contours.
3. Integrate native hollow Google Fonts (`Londrina Outline`, `Bungee Outline`) and provide an interactive switcher in the hero control bar.

### Changes Made
1. **Extracted DevFest Kolkata's Inverted SVG Mask (`cB` architecture)**:
   - Scraped and analyzed `https://www.devfestkolkata.in/_next/static/chunks/f46b74bd0d8f01f0.js`.
   - Identified their exact implementation: an inverted SVG `<mask id="...">` where the outer rect is `#ffffff` and inner text is `#000000`, paired with `<text mask="url(#...)" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4px" (8px on desktop) stroke-linejoin="round">`.
   - This removes 100% of the internal body fill and preserves clean, rounded outer contours without interior overlap or clipping.
2. **Built `OutlineText` Component (`src/components/event/ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`)**:
   - Handles both the DevFest Inverted SVG Mask with authentic `Google Sans` and native Google Fonts outline families (`Londrina Outline`, `Bungee Outline`).
3. **Registered Google Fonts & CSS Rules (`src/app/globals.css`)**:
   - Imported `@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bungee+Outline&family=Londrina+Outline&display=swap");`.
   - Registered `@font-face` for authentic `Google Sans` from `public/fonts/GoogleSans.ttf`.
   - Added `.d4-outline text` and `.d4-outline mask text` CSS rules matching DevFest production specs.
   - Added `.font-londrina-outline` and `.font-bungee-outline`.
4. **Interactive Hero Controls Strip**:
   - Added font mode switcher buttons in the floating HUD:
     - `Google Sans` (DevFest SVG Masked Outline)
     - `Londrina` (Rounded Outline Font)
     - `Bungee` (Geometric Display Outline Font)
   - Allows instant switching and live previewing with zero page reload.

## 2026-11-20 — Smooth Scroll Optimization: Technosahotsava Production Inertia Matching

### Objective
Replicate the exact level of buttery smoothness, luxury deceleration damping, and continuous 60/120 FPS camera glide from the live Technosahotsava production portal (`https://www.technosahotsava.in/`).

### Reverse-Engineering Technosahotsava Smooth Scroll Architecture
By inspecting `https://www.technosahotsava.in/` and decompiling its production bundle (`/assets/index-Dje3lYy2.js`), the exact underlying physics parameters were extracted:
1. **Damping Factor (`lerp: 0.03`)**:
   - Standard Lenis default is `0.1` (or `0.09`).
   - Technosahotsava explicitly sets `lerp: 0.03`. Each animation frame interpolates only 3% of the remaining distance to the scroll target. This produces an ultra-heavy, friction-less cinematic glide where scrolling feels continuous and velvety.
2. **Deceleration Tail (`duration: 2.5`)**:
   - The inertia duration is explicitly set to `2.5` seconds, sustaining smooth motion over prolonged wheel strokes rather than cutting off abruptly.
3. **Dedicated RAF Cycle (`requestAnimationFrame`)**:
   - Directly drives `lenis.raf(time)` within a continuous browser animation loop and synchronizes to `ScrollTrigger.update`.
4. **Scrollbar Jitter Suppression**:
   - Browser default scrollbars are suppressed (`scrollbar-width: none; -ms-overflow-style: none; html::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }`) and body is constrained with `overflow-x: hidden`, eliminating thumb-hopping and horizontal jitter.

### Changes Made
1. **Calibrated Lenis Parameters (`src/components/providers/SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - Configured `lerp: 0.03` and `duration: 2.5` to match `technosahotsava.in` down to the exact mathematical parameters.
   - Tied `lenis.raf(time)` into a dedicated `requestAnimationFrame` loop with `lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)` and `gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)`.
2. **Scrollbar & Layout Polishing (`src/app/globals.css`, `src/app/layout.tsx`)**:
   - Added `scrollbar-width: none; -ms-overflow-style: none;` and `html::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }` to `globals.css`.
   - Added `overflow-x-hidden` to body in `layout.tsx`.
3. **Navbar Programmatic Speed (`src/components/event/Navbar.tsx`)**:
   - Adjusted `SMOOTH_SCROLL_CONFIG.duration` to `1.1` seconds (`power2.out`) for link-click camera transitions.

### Verification
- `npm run build` executed and passed with exit code 0.
- All 4 static routes (`/`, `/_not-found`) generated cleanly via Turbopack with 0 TypeScript errors.

### Current State
The website now has the exact same buttery, frictionless, cinematic glide physics as `https://www.technosahotsava.in/`.

### Next Agent Instructions
- Physics parameters are located in `src/components/providers/SmoothScrollProvider.tsx` (`duration: 2.5, lerp: 0.03, smoothWheel: true`).
- If adjusting the programmatic click duration, modify `SMOOTH_SCROLL_CONFIG.duration` in `src/components/event/Navbar.tsx`.

## 2026-11-20 — Smooth Scroll Fix: Navbar Links & Programmatic Glide Engine

### Objective
Resolve issue where clicking navbar links (`SANSKARAN`, `SAHOTSAVA`, `GALLERY`, `ARCHITECTS`, `PATRONS`, `FOUNDERS`) failed to trigger smooth scrolling to their respective sections.

### Root Cause Analysis
1. **Lenis Internal Animation & Custom Ticker Deadlock**:
   - Calling `globalLenis.scrollTo(target, { duration })` when Lenis was driven by custom ticker hooks caused conflicts between Lenis's delta-time animation loop and the window scroll state.
   - If Lenis received element targets like `#hero`, it calculated `rect.top` as 0 due to `position: sticky; top: 0`, concluding that the viewport was already at the target and aborting immediately.
2. **Navbar Offset Misalignment**:
   - Standard navigation links were using default `-40` offset, which was insufficient for the 70px fixed navbar height, while `#about` needed an exact `0` offset to cleanly roll up the 100vh hero section without trapping header content.

### Changes Made
1. **Hybrid GSAP-Driven Lenis Programmatic Scroll Engine (`SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - Re-architected `lenisScrollTo()` to use GSAP's battle-tested tweening engine:
     ```ts
     gsap.to(scrollObj, {
       y: targetY,
       duration: duration || 1.0,
       ease: "power2.out",
       onUpdate: () => {
         if (globalLenis) {
           globalLenis.scrollTo(scrollObj.y, { immediate: true });
         } else {
           window.scrollTo(0, scrollObj.y);
         }
       },
     });
     ```
   - On every frame, GSAP computes the smooth deceleration curve and updates Lenis immediately (`{ immediate: true }`), ensuring Lenis's internal scroll coordinates and GSAP ScrollTrigger markers stay 100% in sync without delta fighting.
   - Calculated exact absolute target Y: `targetY = currentScroll + rect.top + offset`, clamped between `0` and `maxScroll`.
   - Handled all "Back to Top" targets (`#hero`, `hero`, `top`, `#top`, `0`) explicitly to force `targetY = 0` and emit `hero:restart-loop`.
2. **Configured Navbar Clearances (`Navbar.tsx`)**:
   - Updated `SMOOTH_SCROLL_CONFIG.offset` to `-70` to match the exact height of the fixed navigation bar.
   - Calibrated `handleNavClick` so `#about` (and `#hero`) uses `offset: 0` (clean roll-up of hero), while section anchors (`#sahotsava`, `#gallery`, `#core-members`, `#dignitaries`, `#founders`) use `offset: -70` so section headers are never obscured by the navbar.
3. **Optimized Natural Inertia (`SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - Lenis configured with `lerp: 0.09` for mouse wheel and touchpad momentum damping.
   - Synchronized with `lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)` and `gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)`.
4. **Hero Explore CTA Alignment (`page.tsx`, `ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`)**:
   - Configured Explore CTA and hero chevron to scroll to `#about` with `offset: 0`.

### Files Changed
- `src/components/providers/SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`
- `src/components/event/Navbar.tsx`
- `src/app/page.tsx`
- `src/components/event/ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`
- `tracker.md`
- `features_implemented.md`

### Verification
- `npm run build` executed and passed with exit code 0.
- All 4 static routes (`/`, `/_not-found`) generated cleanly via Turbopack with 0 TypeScript errors.

### Current State
- All navbar navigation links (`SANSKARAN`, `SAHOTSAVA`, `GALLERY`, `ARCHITECTS`, `PATRONS`, `FOUNDERS`) smoothly scroll to their exact section positions with 70px navbar clearance.
- "Explore" CTA and hero chevron smoothly roll up the 100vh hero to `#about`.
- "Back to Top" in the footer and navbar logo smoothly returns to `y = 0` and replays the hero intro loop.
- Natural scrolling retains 60 FPS inertia with Lenis and GSAP ScrollTrigger.

## 2026-11-20 — Smooth Scroll Fix: Explore & Back to Top Absolute Coordinate Alignment

### Objective
Diagnose and permanently fix the broken smooth scroll on the **Explore** and **Back to Top** buttons.

### Root Cause Analysis
1. **Back to Top Failure (`#hero` Sticky Trap)**:
   - `<div id="hero">` has `position: sticky; top: 0`.
   - When scrolled down anywhere on the page, `#hero.getBoundingClientRect().top` is `0`.
   - Passing `target: "#hero"` into Lenis caused it to calculate `target = rect.top + animatedScroll = 0 + scroll = scroll` (the current position).
   - Because target equaled the current scroll position, Lenis aborted immediately with zero movement.
2. **Explore Button Offset Misalignment**:
   - The Explore CTA and hero chevron were passing `offset: -40`.
   - Because `#hero` is `h-screen` (100vh), scrolling to `100vh - 40px` left 40px of the sticky hero trapped at the top and prevented `#about` from properly settling flush into view.

### Changes Made
1. **Mathematical Absolute Pixel Resolution (`SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - `lenisScrollTo` now explicitly intercepts all "Back to Top" targets (`#hero`, `hero`, `top`, `#top`, `0`).
   - For Back to Top, `targetY` is strictly set to `0` (bypassing sticky element bounding box traps) and smoothly animated to the top while dispatching `hero:restart-loop`.
   - For Explore and all page sections, `targetY` is computed as `(window.scrollY + rect.top + offset)`, clamped between `0` and `maxScroll`, and fed into `globalLenis.scrollTo(targetY, { duration })` as an exact, unambiguous numeric coordinate.
2. **Aligned Explore Offset to `0` (`Navbar.tsx`, `page.tsx`, `ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`)**:
   - Configured `offset: 0` for `target === "#about"` and `target === "#hero"`.
   - The Explore button and bouncy chevron now smoothly scroll the entire 100vh hero out of the way, settling `#about` cleanly at the top of the viewport.
3. **Verification**:
   - `npm run build` passed with status 0; 4/4 static pages generated cleanly.

### Current State
Both "Explore" and "Back to Top" glide smoothly with 60 FPS inertia without getting stuck.

## 2026-11-17 — Elimination of Oval Warping & Snapping in Slit Expansion (/gsap-animation & /animate)

### Objective
Fix the jarring animation defect where vertical slits warped into an elongated oval before abruptly snapping/clipping back into a rectangle. Use `/gsap-animation` and `/animate` principles to make the expansion silky-smooth, physically consistent, and artifact-free.

### Root Cause Analysis
1. **Conflicting Border Radii (`rounded-full` to `rounded-2xl`)**: The collapsed slit had `rounded-full` (`border-radius: 9999px`) while the expanded card had `rounded-2xl` (`16px`). During Framer Motion's `layout` scale projection (where the element scaled from height 48px to 850px), the 9999px border-radius was stretched non-uniformly by `scaleY`, ballooning outward into a giant distorted oval.
2. **Conflicting CSS Transitions**: `transition-all duration-300` was placed on the same DOM element animated by Framer Motion's layout engine. When the 300ms CSS transition expired, the browser abruptly clipped the element back to a rectangle.

### Changes Made
1. **Unified Rectangular Geometry (`src/components/event/GallerySection.tsx`)**:
   - Replaced `rounded-full` with constant, elegant `rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl` across both collapsed and expanded states.
   - Because the border radius is identical in both states, **zero border-radius distortion or oval bulging can ever occur**.
2. **Removed Conflicting CSS Transitions**:
   - Eliminated `transition-all duration-300`.
   - Isolated transitions strictly to non-layout composite styles: `transition: background-color 400ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 400ms, box-shadow 400ms`.
3. **Applied Premium Apple / GSAP Easing Curve**:
   - Configured `transition={{ layout: { duration: 0.42, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] } }}` (canonical `expo.out` / `power3.out` curve) for a natural, physically grounded deceleration.
   - Smoothly revealed expanded content with `duration: 0.32, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]`.

- [features_implemented.md](file:///f:/C++/codes/Hackathons/Saskaran%20deck%20of%20cards%202026%20static%20site%20-%20Copy/features_implemented.md)
- [tracker.md](file:///f:/C++/codes/Hackathons/Saskaran%20deck%20of%20cards%202026%20static%20site%20-%20Copy/tracker.md)

## 2026-11-17 — Skiper17 GSAP ScrollTrigger Smooth Section Elevation & Card Stack Engine

### Objective
Recreate the smooth GSAP scroll animation from Skiper 17 (`https://skiper-ui.com/v1/skiper17`) using `/gsap-animation` to make the "What is Sanskaran & What is Sahotsava" section glide up smoothly over the hero video with physical card depth, and implement an interactive Skiper17 card stack mode.

### Changes Made
1. **Extracted and Analyzed Skiper17 Registry Source (`skiper-ui.com/r/skiper17.json`)**:
   - Analyzed `StickyCard002`: Uses `ScrollTrigger` with `scrub: 0.5-0.8`, `pin: true`, GPU composite transforms (`yPercent`, `scale`, `rotation`).
   - Cards stack by shrinking and rotating the underlayer (`scale: 0.88`, `rotation: -4deg`, `opacity: 0.6`) while the incoming card glides up (`y: "0%"`).
2. **Engineered Macro Smooth Section Elevation (`src/components/event/AboutFestivalSection.tsx`)**:
   - Pinned hero video background (`#hero-canvas-inner`) via `will-change-transform`.
   - As the user scrolls from the hero into `#about`, GSAP `ScrollTrigger` scrubs the card sheet from `y: 200, scale: 0.94` up to `y: 0, scale: 1.0` with `scrub: 0.8`.
   - Concurrently, `#hero-canvas-inner` recedes into 3D space (`scale: 0.88, y: -60, opacity: 0.45`), giving the signature physical card stacking depth from Skiper 17.
3. **Interactive Skiper17 Card Stack Engine**:
   - Built a live layout switcher in the header controls:
     - `⊞ Grid`: Responsive side-by-side 12-column duality card layout.
     - `🂠 Skiper17 Stack`: Interactive sticky stacked deck replicating `StickyCard002` where Card 1 (Sanskaran, A ♠) pins, scales down, and rotates `-4deg` as Card 2 (Sahotsava, K ♦) glides up directly over it with GSAP scrub.
4. **Hero Canvas Connector (`src/components/event/ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`)**:
   - Tagged `#hero-canvas-inner` with `will-change-transform origin-center` so GSAP can hardware-accelerate the receding transition.

## 2026-11-17 — Hollow Outline Typography & Google Outline Fonts Integration

### Changes Made
1. **Extracted DevFest Kolkata's Inverted SVG Mask (`cB` architecture)**:
   - Scraped and analyzed `https://www.devfestkolkata.in/_next/static/chunks/f46b74bd0d8f01f0.js`.
   - Identified their exact implementation: an inverted SVG `<mask id="...">` where the outer rect is `#ffffff` and inner text is `#000000`, paired with `<text mask="url(#...)" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4px" (8px on desktop) stroke-linejoin="round">`.
   - This removes 100% of the internal body fill and preserves clean, rounded outer contours without interior overlap or clipping.
2. **Built `OutlineText` Component (`src/components/event/ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`)**:

   - Registered `@font-face` for authentic `Google Sans` from `public/fonts/GoogleSans.ttf`.
   - Added `.d4-outline text` and `.d4-outline mask text` CSS rules matching DevFest production specs.
   - Added `.font-londrina-outline` and `.font-bungee-outline`.
4. **Interactive Hero Controls Strip**:

## 2026-11-20 — Smooth Scroll Optimization: Technosahotsava Production Inertia Matching

### Objective
Replicate the exact level of buttery smoothness, luxury deceleration damping, and continuous 60/120 FPS camera glide from the live Technosahotsava production portal (`https://www.technosahotsava.in/`).

### Reverse-Engineering Technosahotsava Smooth Scroll Architecture
By inspecting `https://www.technosahotsava.in/` and decompiling its production bundle (`/assets/index-Dje3lYy2.js`), the exact underlying physics parameters were extracted:
1. **Damping Factor (`lerp: 0.03`)**:
   - Standard Lenis default is `0.1` (or `0.09`).
   - Technosahotsava explicitly sets `lerp: 0.03`. Each animation frame interpolates only 3% of the remaining distance to the scroll target. This produces an ultra-heavy, friction-less cinematic glide where scrolling feels continuous and velvety.
2. **Deceleration Tail (`duration: 2.5`)**:
   - The inertia duration is explicitly set to `2.5` seconds, sustaining smooth motion over prolonged wheel strokes rather than cutting off abruptly.
3. **Dedicated RAF Cycle (`requestAnimationFrame`)**:
   - Directly drives `lenis.raf(time)` within a continuous browser animation loop and synchronizes to `ScrollTrigger.update`.
4. **Scrollbar Jitter Suppression**:
   - Browser default scrollbars are suppressed (`scrollbar-width: none; -ms-overflow-style: none; html::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }`) and body is constrained with `overflow-x: hidden`, eliminating thumb-hopping and horizontal jitter.

### Changes Made
1. **Calibrated Lenis Parameters (`src/components/providers/SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - Configured `lerp: 0.03` and `duration: 2.5` to match `technosahotsava.in` down to the exact mathematical parameters.
   - Tied `lenis.raf(time)` into a dedicated `requestAnimationFrame` loop with `lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)` and `gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)`.
2. **Scrollbar & Layout Polishing (`src/app/globals.css`, `src/app/layout.tsx`)**:
   - Added `scrollbar-width: none; -ms-overflow-style: none;` and `html::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }` to `globals.css`.
   - Added `overflow-x-hidden` to body in `layout.tsx`.
3. **Navbar Programmatic Speed (`src/components/event/Navbar.tsx`)**:
   - Adjusted `SMOOTH_SCROLL_CONFIG.duration` to `1.1` seconds (`power2.out`) for link-click camera transitions.

- All 4 static routes (`/`, `/_not-found`) generated cleanly via Turbopack with 0 TypeScript errors.

## 2026-11-20 — Smooth Scroll Fix: Navbar Links & Programmatic Glide Engine

### Objective
Resolve issue where clicking navbar links (`SANSKARAN`, `SAHOTSAVA`, `GALLERY`, `ARCHITECTS`, `PATRONS`, `FOUNDERS`) failed to trigger smooth scrolling to their respective sections.

### Root Cause Analysis
1. **Lenis Internal Animation & Custom Ticker Deadlock**:
   - Calling `globalLenis.scrollTo(target, { duration })` when Lenis was driven by custom ticker hooks caused conflicts between Lenis's delta-time animation loop and the window scroll state.
   - If Lenis received element targets like `#hero`, it calculated `rect.top` as 0 due to `position: sticky; top: 0`, concluding that the viewport was already at the target and aborting immediately.
2. **Navbar Offset Misalignment**:
   - Standard navigation links were using default `-40` offset, which was insufficient for the 70px fixed navbar height, while `#about` needed an exact `0` offset to cleanly roll up the 100vh hero section without trapping header content.

### Changes Made
1. **Hybrid GSAP-Driven Lenis Programmatic Scroll Engine (`SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - Re-architected `lenisScrollTo()` to use GSAP's battle-tested tweening engine:
     ```ts
     gsap.to(scrollObj, {
       y: targetY,
       duration: duration || 1.0,
       ease: "power2.out",
       onUpdate: () => {
         if (globalLenis) {
           globalLenis.scrollTo(scrollObj.y, { immediate: true });
         } else {
           window.scrollTo(0, scrollObj.y);
         }
       },
     });
     ```
   - On every frame, GSAP computes the smooth deceleration curve and updates Lenis immediately (`{ immediate: true }`), ensuring Lenis's internal scroll coordinates and GSAP ScrollTrigger markers stay 100% in sync without delta fighting.
   - Calculated exact absolute target Y: `targetY = currentScroll + rect.top + offset`, clamped between `0` and `maxScroll`.
   - Handled all "Back to Top" targets (`#hero`, `hero`, `top`, `#top`, `0`) explicitly to force `targetY = 0` and emit `hero:restart-loop`.
2. **Configured Navbar Clearances (`Navbar.tsx`)**:
   - Updated `SMOOTH_SCROLL_CONFIG.offset` to `-70` to match the exact height of the fixed navigation bar.
   - Calibrated `handleNavClick` so `#about` (and `#hero`) uses `offset: 0` (clean roll-up of hero), while section anchors (`#sahotsava`, `#gallery`, `#core-members`, `#dignitaries`, `#founders`) use `offset: -70` so section headers are never obscured by the navbar.
3. **Optimized Natural Inertia (`SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - Lenis configured with `lerp: 0.09` for mouse wheel and touchpad momentum damping.
   - Synchronized with `lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)` and `gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)`.
4. **Hero Explore CTA Alignment (`page.tsx`, `ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`)**:
   - Configured Explore CTA and hero chevron to scroll to `#about` with `offset: 0`.

### Files Changed
- `src/components/providers/SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`
- `src/components/event/Navbar.tsx`
- `src/app/page.tsx`
- `src/components/event/ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`
- `tracker.md`
- `features_implemented.md`

### Verification
- `npm run build` executed and passed with exit code 0.
- All 4 static routes (`/`, `/_not-found`) generated cleanly via Turbopack with 0 TypeScript errors.

### Current State

- "Explore" CTA and hero chevron smoothly roll up the 100vh hero to `#about`.

## 2026-11-20 — Smooth Scroll Fix: Explore & Back to Top Absolute Coordinate Alignment

### Objective
Diagnose and permanently fix the broken smooth scroll on the **Explore** and **Back to Top** buttons.

### Root Cause Analysis
1. **Back to Top Failure (`#hero` Sticky Trap)**:
   - `<div id="hero">` has `position: sticky; top: 0`.
   - When scrolled down anywhere on the page, `#hero.getBoundingClientRect().top` is `0`.
   - Passing `target: "#hero"` into Lenis caused it to calculate `target = rect.top + animatedScroll = 0 + scroll = scroll` (the current position).
   - Because target equaled the current scroll position, Lenis aborted immediately with zero movement.
2. **Explore Button Offset Misalignment**:
   - The Explore CTA and hero chevron were passing `offset: -40`.
   - Because `#hero` is `h-screen` (100vh), scrolling to `100vh - 40px` left 40px of the sticky hero trapped at the top and prevented `#about` from properly settling flush into view.

### Changes Made
1. **Mathematical Absolute Pixel Resolution (`SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - `lenisScrollTo` now explicitly intercepts all "Back to Top" targets (`#hero`, `hero`, `top`, `#top`, `0`).
   - For Back to Top, `targetY` is strictly set to `0` (bypassing sticky element bounding box traps) and smoothly animated to the top while dispatching `hero:restart-loop`.
   - For Explore and all page sections, `targetY` is computed as `(window.scrollY + rect.top + offset)`, clamped between `0` and `maxScroll`, and fed into `globalLenis.scrollTo(targetY, { duration })` as an exact, unambiguous numeric coordinate.
2. **Aligned Explore Offset to `0` (`Navbar.tsx`, `page.tsx`, `ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`)**:
   - Configured `offset: 0` for `target === "#about"` and `target === "#hero"`.
   - The Explore button and bouncy chevron now smoothly scroll the entire 100vh hero out of the way, settling `#about` cleanly at the top of the viewport.
3. **Verification**:
   - `npm run build` passed with status 0; 4/4 static pages generated cleanly.

### Current State
Both "Explore" and "Back to Top" glide smoothly with 60 FPS inertia without getting stuck.

## 2026-11-17 — Elimination of Oval Warping & Snapping in Slit Expansion (/gsap-animation & /animate)

### Objective
Fix the jarring animation defect where vertical slits warped into an elongated oval before abruptly snapping/clipping back into a rectangle. Use `/gsap-animation` and `/animate` principles to make the expansion silky-smooth, physically consistent, and artifact-free.

### Root Cause Analysis
1. **Conflicting Border Radii (`rounded-full` to `rounded-2xl`)**: The collapsed slit had `rounded-full` (`border-radius: 9999px`) while the expanded card had `rounded-2xl` (`16px`). During Framer Motion's `layout` scale projection (where the element scaled from height 48px to 850px), the 9999px border-radius was stretched non-uniformly by `scaleY`, ballooning outward into a giant distorted oval.
2. **Conflicting CSS Transitions**: `transition-all duration-300` was placed on the same DOM element animated by Framer Motion's layout engine. When the 300ms CSS transition expired, the browser abruptly clipped the element back to a rectangle.

### Changes Made
1. **Unified Rectangular Geometry (`src/components/event/GallerySection.tsx`)**:
   - Replaced `rounded-full` with constant, elegant `rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl` across both collapsed and expanded states.
   - Because the border radius is identical in both states, **zero border-radius distortion or oval bulging can ever occur**.
2. **Removed Conflicting CSS Transitions**:
   - Eliminated `transition-all duration-300`.
   - Isolated transitions strictly to non-layout composite styles: `transition: background-color 400ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 400ms, box-shadow 400ms`.
3. **Applied Premium Apple / GSAP Easing Curve**:
   - Configured `transition={{ layout: { duration: 0.42, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] } }}` (canonical `expo.out` / `power3.out` curve) for a natural, physically grounded deceleration.
   - Smoothly revealed expanded content with `duration: 0.32, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]`.

## 2026-11-20 — Smooth Scroll Optimization: Technosahotsava Production Inertia Matching

### Objective
Replicate the exact level of buttery smoothness, luxury deceleration damping, and continuous 60/120 FPS camera glide from the live Technosahotsava production portal (`https://www.technosahotsava.in/`).

### Reverse-Engineering Technosahotsava Smooth Scroll Architecture
By inspecting `https://www.technosahotsava.in/` and decompiling its production bundle (`/assets/index-Dje3lYy2.js`), the exact underlying physics parameters were extracted:
1. **Damping Factor (`lerp: 0.03`)**:
   - Standard Lenis default is `0.1` (or `0.09`).
   - Technosahotsava explicitly sets `lerp: 0.03`. Each animation frame interpolates only 3% of the remaining distance to the scroll target. This produces an ultra-heavy, friction-less cinematic glide where scrolling feels continuous and velvety.
2. **Deceleration Tail (`duration: 2.5`)**:
   - The inertia duration is explicitly set to `2.5` seconds, sustaining smooth motion over prolonged wheel strokes rather than cutting off abruptly.
3. **Dedicated RAF Cycle (`requestAnimationFrame`)**:
   - Directly drives `lenis.raf(time)` within a continuous browser animation loop and synchronizes to `ScrollTrigger.update`.
4. **Scrollbar Jitter Suppression**:
   - Browser default scrollbars are suppressed (`scrollbar-width: none; -ms-overflow-style: none; html::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }`) and body is constrained with `overflow-x: hidden`, eliminating thumb-hopping and horizontal jitter.

### Changes Made
1. **Calibrated Lenis Parameters (`src/components/providers/SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - Configured `lerp: 0.03` and `duration: 2.5` to match `technosahotsava.in` down to the exact mathematical parameters.
   - Tied `lenis.raf(time)` into a dedicated `requestAnimationFrame` loop with `lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)` and `gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)`.
2. **Scrollbar & Layout Polishing (`src/app/globals.css`, `src/app/layout.tsx`)**:
   - Added `scrollbar-width: none; -ms-overflow-style: none;` and `html::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }` to `globals.css`.
   - Added `overflow-x-hidden` to body in `layout.tsx`.
3. **Navbar Programmatic Speed (`src/components/event/Navbar.tsx`)**:
   - Adjusted `SMOOTH_SCROLL_CONFIG.duration` to `1.1` seconds (`power2.out`) for link-click camera transitions.

### Verification
- `npm run build` executed and passed with exit code 0.
- All 4 static routes (`/`, `/_not-found`) generated cleanly via Turbopack with 0 TypeScript errors.

### Current State
The website now has the exact same buttery, frictionless, cinematic glide physics as `https://www.technosahotsava.in/`.

## 2026-11-20 — Smooth Scroll Fix: Navbar Links & Programmatic Glide Engine

### Objective
Resolve issue where clicking navbar links (`SANSKARAN`, `SAHOTSAVA`, `GALLERY`, `ARCHITECTS`, `PATRONS`, `FOUNDERS`) failed to trigger smooth scrolling to their respective sections.

### Root Cause Analysis
1. **Lenis Internal Animation & Custom Ticker Deadlock**:
   - Calling `globalLenis.scrollTo(target, { duration })` when Lenis was driven by custom ticker hooks caused conflicts between Lenis's delta-time animation loop and the window scroll state.
   - If Lenis received element targets like `#hero`, it calculated `rect.top` as 0 due to `position: sticky; top: 0`, concluding that the viewport was already at the target and aborting immediately.
2. **Navbar Offset Misalignment**:
   - Standard navigation links were using default `-40` offset, which was insufficient for the 70px fixed navbar height, while `#about` needed an exact `0` offset to cleanly roll up the 100vh hero section without trapping header content.

### Changes Made
1. **Hybrid GSAP-Driven Lenis Programmatic Scroll Engine (`SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - Re-architected `lenisScrollTo()` to use GSAP's battle-tested tweening engine:
     ```ts
     gsap.to(scrollObj, {
       y: targetY,
       duration: duration || 1.0,
       ease: "power2.out",
       onUpdate: () => {
         if (globalLenis) {
           globalLenis.scrollTo(scrollObj.y, { immediate: true });
         } else {
           window.scrollTo(0, scrollObj.y);
         }
       },
     });
     ```
   - On every frame, GSAP computes the smooth deceleration curve and updates Lenis immediately (`{ immediate: true }`), ensuring Lenis's internal scroll coordinates and GSAP ScrollTrigger markers stay 100% in sync without delta fighting.
   - Calculated exact absolute target Y: `targetY = currentScroll + rect.top + offset`, clamped between `0` and `maxScroll`.
   - Handled all "Back to Top" targets (`#hero`, `hero`, `top`, `#top`, `0`) explicitly to force `targetY = 0` and emit `hero:restart-loop`.
2. **Configured Navbar Clearances (`Navbar.tsx`)**:

## 2026-11-20 — Smooth Scroll Fix: Explore & Back to Top Absolute Coordinate Alignment

### Objective
Diagnose and permanently fix the broken smooth scroll on the **Explore** and **Back to Top** buttons.

### Root Cause Analysis
1. **Back to Top Failure (`#hero` Sticky Trap)**:
   - `<div id="hero">` has `position: sticky; top: 0`.
   - When scrolled down anywhere on the page, `#hero.getBoundingClientRect().top` is `0`.
   - Passing `target: "#hero"` into Lenis caused it to calculate `target = rect.top + animatedScroll = 0 + scroll = scroll` (the current position).
   - Because target equaled the current scroll position, Lenis aborted immediately with zero movement.
2. **Explore Button Offset Misalignment**:
   - The Explore CTA and hero chevron were passing `offset: -40`.
   - Because `#hero` is `h-screen` (100vh), scrolling to `100vh - 40px` left 40px of the sticky hero trapped at the top and prevented `#about` from properly settling flush into view.

### Changes Made
1. **Mathematical Absolute Pixel Resolution (`SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - `lenisScrollTo` now explicitly intercepts all "Back to Top" targets (`#hero`, `hero`, `top`, `#top`, `0`).
   - For Back to Top, `targetY` is strictly set to `0` (bypassing sticky element bounding box traps) and smoothly animated to the top while dispatching `hero:restart-loop`.
   - For Explore and all page sections, `targetY` is computed as `(window.scrollY + rect.top + offset)`, clamped between `0` and `maxScroll`, and fed into `globalLenis.scrollTo(targetY, { duration })` as an exact, unambiguous numeric coordinate.
2. **Aligned Explore Offset to `0` (`Navbar.tsx`, `page.tsx`, `ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`)**:
   - Configured `offset: 0` for `target === "#about"` and `target === "#hero"`.
   - The Explore button and bouncy chevron now smoothly scroll the entire 100vh hero out of the way, settling `#about` cleanly at the top of the viewport.
3. **Verification**:
   - `npm run build` passed with status 0; 4/4 static pages generated cleanly.

### Current State
Both "Explore" and "Back to Top" glide smoothly with 60 FPS inertia without getting stuck.

### Next Agent Instructions
1. Inspect `src/components/providers/SmoothScrollProvider.tsx` lines 30-75 for `lenisScrollTo` coordinate calculation.
2. Keep `origin` and `trial` remotes synchronized.

## 2026-11-20 — 60 FPS Buttery-Smooth Inertia Scroll Engine & GSAP ScrollTrigger Integration

### Objective
Implement an always-smooth 60 FPS inertia scroll engine across the entire festival portal using `/gsap-animation` guardrails and `/context7-mcp` documentation on GSAP ScrollTrigger and smooth scroll synchronization.

### Changes Made
1. **Context7 Documentation Lookup**:
   - Resolved documentation for GSAP and Lenis via Context7 MCP (`/greensock/gsap-skills`, `/websites/gsap`, `/darkroomengineering/lenis`).
   - Retrieved official synchronization patterns: `lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)`, binding Lenis `raf` to `gsap.ticker.add((time) => lenis.raf(time * 1000))`, and disabling GSAP lag smoothing (`gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)`).
2. **Installed `lenis` Package**:
   - Added `"lenis": "^1.3.27"` and verified `node_modules/lenis/dist/lenis.css`.
3. **Engineered `SmoothScrollProvider` (`src/components/providers/SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - Initialized Lenis with 60 FPS inertia momentum configuration:
     - `duration: 1.2`
     - `easing: (t) => Math.min(1, 1.001 - Math.pow(2, -10 * t))`
     - `orientation: "vertical"`
     - `smoothWheel: true`
     - `wheelMultiplier: 1.0`
     - `touchMultiplier: 1.8`
   - Bound Lenis directly to `gsap.ticker` so scroll inertia updates in 1:1 lockstep with GSAP's master clock at 60 FPS.
   - Wired `lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)` to eliminate trigger jitter and position drift.
   - Disabled lag smoothing via `gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)`.
   - Exported global `lenisScrollTo` and `getLenis()` programmatic functions.
4. **Global Root Layout Integration (`src/app/layout.tsx`)**:
   - Imported `lenis/dist/lenis.css` to configure standard overscroll behavior and prevent layout jitter.
   - Wrapped page children with `<SmoothScrollProvider>`.
5. **Unified Navigation & Footer Scroll Handling**:
   - Updated `gsapScrollTo` in `src/components/event/Navbar.tsx` to automatically route through `lenisScrollTo` with seamless fallback.
   - Updated `Footer.tsx` "Back to Top" button to trigger `gsapScrollTo("#hero", 1.2, 0)` which dispatches the `hero:restart-loop` event.
6. **Verification**:
   - Executed `npm run build`: Compiled cleanly in 5.7s with 0 TypeScript/Turbopack errors; 4/4 static pages generated successfully.

### Current State
The entire application scrolls with continuous, buttery-smooth 60 FPS inertia motion. All GSAP ScrollTrigger animations remain locked to scroll velocity without stutter.

## 2026-11-17 — Elimination of Oval Warping & Snapping in Slit Expansion (/gsap-animation & /animate)

### Objective
Fix the jarring animation defect where vertical slits warped into an elongated oval before abruptly snapping/clipping back into a rectangle. Use `/gsap-animation` and `/animate` principles to make the expansion silky-smooth, physically consistent, and artifact-free.

### Root Cause Analysis
1. **Conflicting Border Radii (`rounded-full` to `rounded-2xl`)**: The collapsed slit had `rounded-full` (`border-radius: 9999px`) while the expanded card had `rounded-2xl` (`16px`). During Framer Motion's `layout` scale projection (where the element scaled from height 48px to 850px), the 9999px border-radius was stretched non-uniformly by `scaleY`, ballooning outward into a giant distorted oval.
2. **Conflicting CSS Transitions**: `transition-all duration-300` was placed on the same DOM element animated by Framer Motion's layout engine. When the 300ms CSS transition expired, the browser abruptly clipped the element back to a rectangle.

### Changes Made
1. **Unified Rectangular Geometry (`src/components/event/GallerySection.tsx`)**:
   - Replaced `rounded-full` with constant, elegant `rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl` across both collapsed and expanded states.
   - Because the border radius is identical in both states, **zero border-radius distortion or oval bulging can ever occur**.
2. **Removed Conflicting CSS Transitions**:
   - Eliminated `transition-all duration-300`.
   - Isolated transitions strictly to non-layout composite styles: `transition: background-color 400ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 400ms, box-shadow 400ms`.
3. **Applied Premium Apple / GSAP Easing Curve**:
   - Configured `transition={{ layout: { duration: 0.42, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] } }}` (canonical `expo.out` / `power3.out` curve) for a natural, physically grounded deceleration.
   - Smoothly revealed expanded content with `duration: 0.32, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]`.

## 2026-11-20 — Smooth Scroll Optimization: Technosahotsava Production Inertia Matching

### Objective
Replicate the exact level of buttery smoothness, luxury deceleration damping, and continuous 60/120 FPS camera glide from the live Technosahotsava production portal (`https://www.technosahotsava.in/`).

### Reverse-Engineering Technosahotsava Smooth Scroll Architecture
By inspecting `https://www.technosahotsava.in/` and decompiling its production bundle (`/assets/index-Dje3lYy2.js`), the exact underlying physics parameters were extracted:
1. **Damping Factor (`lerp: 0.03`)**:
   - Standard Lenis default is `0.1` (or `0.09`).
   - Technosahotsava explicitly sets `lerp: 0.03`. Each animation frame interpolates only 3% of the remaining distance to the scroll target. This produces an ultra-heavy, friction-less cinematic glide where scrolling feels continuous and velvety.
2. **Deceleration Tail (`duration: 2.5`)**:
   - The inertia duration is explicitly set to `2.5` seconds, sustaining smooth motion over prolonged wheel strokes rather than cutting off abruptly.
3. **Dedicated RAF Cycle (`requestAnimationFrame`)**:
   - Directly drives `lenis.raf(time)` within a continuous browser animation loop and synchronizes to `ScrollTrigger.update`.
4. **Scrollbar Jitter Suppression**:
   - Browser default scrollbars are suppressed (`scrollbar-width: none; -ms-overflow-style: none; html::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }`) and body is constrained with `overflow-x: hidden`, eliminating thumb-hopping and horizontal jitter.

### Changes Made
1. **Calibrated Lenis Parameters (`src/components/providers/SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - Configured `lerp: 0.03` and `duration: 2.5` to match `technosahotsava.in` down to the exact mathematical parameters.
   - Tied `lenis.raf(time)` into a dedicated `requestAnimationFrame` loop with `lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)` and `gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)`.
2. **Scrollbar & Layout Polishing (`src/app/globals.css`, `src/app/layout.tsx`)**:
   - Added `scrollbar-width: none; -ms-overflow-style: none;` and `html::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }` to `globals.css`.
   - Added `overflow-x-hidden` to body in `layout.tsx`.
3. **Navbar Programmatic Speed (`src/components/event/Navbar.tsx`)**:
   - Adjusted `SMOOTH_SCROLL_CONFIG.duration` to `1.1` seconds (`power2.out`) for link-click camera transitions.

### Verification
- `npm run build` executed and passed with exit code 0.
- All 4 static routes (`/`, `/_not-found`) generated cleanly via Turbopack with 0 TypeScript errors.

### Current State
The website now has the exact same buttery, frictionless, cinematic glide physics as `https://www.technosahotsava.in/`.

## 2026-11-20 — Smooth Scroll Fix: Navbar Links & Programmatic Glide Engine

### Objective
Resolve issue where clicking navbar links (`SANSKARAN`, `SAHOTSAVA`, `GALLERY`, `ARCHITECTS`, `PATRONS`, `FOUNDERS`) failed to trigger smooth scrolling to their respective sections.

### Root Cause Analysis
1. **Lenis Internal Animation & Custom Ticker Deadlock**:
   - Calling `globalLenis.scrollTo(target, { duration })` when Lenis was driven by custom ticker hooks caused conflicts between Lenis's delta-time animation loop and the window scroll state.
   - If Lenis received element targets like `#hero`, it calculated `rect.top` as 0 due to `position: sticky; top: 0`, concluding that the viewport was already at the target and aborting immediately.
2. **Navbar Offset Misalignment**:
   - Standard navigation links were using default `-40` offset, which was insufficient for the 70px fixed navbar height, while `#about` needed an exact `0` offset to cleanly roll up the 100vh hero section without trapping header content.

### Changes Made
1. **Hybrid GSAP-Driven Lenis Programmatic Scroll Engine (`SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - Re-architected `lenisScrollTo()` to use GSAP's battle-tested tweening engine:
     ```ts
     gsap.to(scrollObj, {
       y: targetY,
       duration: duration || 1.0,
       ease: "power2.out",
       onUpdate: () => {
         if (globalLenis) {
           globalLenis.scrollTo(scrollObj.y, { immediate: true });
         } else {
           window.scrollTo(0, scrollObj.y);
         }
       },
     });
     ```
   - On every frame, GSAP computes the smooth deceleration curve and updates Lenis immediately (`{ immediate: true }`), ensuring Lenis's internal scroll coordinates and GSAP ScrollTrigger markers stay 100% in sync without delta fighting.
   - Calculated exact absolute target Y: `targetY = currentScroll + rect.top + offset`, clamped between `0` and `maxScroll`.
   - Handled all "Back to Top" targets (`#hero`, `hero`, `top`, `#top`, `0`) explicitly to force `targetY = 0` and emit `hero:restart-loop`.
2. **Configured Navbar Clearances (`Navbar.tsx`)**:
   - Updated `SMOOTH_SCROLL_CONFIG.offset` to `-70` to match the exact height of the fixed navigation bar.
   - Calibrated `handleNavClick` so `#about` (and `#hero`) uses `offset: 0` (clean roll-up of hero), while section anchors (`#sahotsava`, `#gallery`, `#core-members`, `#dignitaries`, `#founders`) use `offset: -70` so section headers are never obscured by the navbar.
3. **Optimized Natural Inertia (`SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - Lenis configured with `lerp: 0.09` for mouse wheel and touchpad momentum damping.
   - Synchronized with `lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)` and `gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)`.
4. **Hero Explore CTA Alignment (`page.tsx`, `ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`)**:
   - Configured Explore CTA and hero chevron to scroll to `#about` with `offset: 0`.

## 2026-11-20 — Smooth Scroll Fix: Explore & Back to Top Absolute Coordinate Alignment

### Objective
Diagnose and permanently fix the broken smooth scroll on the **Explore** and **Back to Top** buttons.

### Root Cause Analysis
1. **Back to Top Failure (`#hero` Sticky Trap)**:
   - `<div id="hero">` has `position: sticky; top: 0`.
   - When scrolled down anywhere on the page, `#hero.getBoundingClientRect().top` is `0`.
   - Passing `target: "#hero"` into Lenis caused it to calculate `target = rect.top + animatedScroll = 0 + scroll = scroll` (the current position).
   - Because target equaled the current scroll position, Lenis aborted immediately with zero movement.
2. **Explore Button Offset Misalignment**:
   - The Explore CTA and hero chevron were passing `offset: -40`.
   - Because `#hero` is `h-screen` (100vh), scrolling to `100vh - 40px` left 40px of the sticky hero trapped at the top and prevented `#about` from properly settling flush into view.

### Changes Made
1. **Mathematical Absolute Pixel Resolution (`SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - `lenisScrollTo` now explicitly intercepts all "Back to Top" targets (`#hero`, `hero`, `top`, `#top`, `0`).
   - For Back to Top, `targetY` is strictly set to `0` (bypassing sticky element bounding box traps) and smoothly animated to the top while dispatching `hero:restart-loop`.
   - For Explore and all page sections, `targetY` is computed as `(window.scrollY + rect.top + offset)`, clamped between `0` and `maxScroll`, and fed into `globalLenis.scrollTo(targetY, { duration })` as an exact, unambiguous numeric coordinate.
2. **Aligned Explore Offset to `0` (`Navbar.tsx`, `page.tsx`, `ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`)**:
   - Configured `offset: 0` for `target === "#about"` and `target === "#hero"`.
   - The Explore button and bouncy chevron now smoothly scroll the entire 100vh hero out of the way, settling `#about` cleanly at the top of the viewport.
3. **Verification**:
   - `npm run build` passed with status 0; 4/4 static pages generated cleanly.

### Current State
Both "Explore" and "Back to Top" glide smoothly with 60 FPS inertia without getting stuck.

## 2026-11-20 — Hero Slideshow: Observer Transform Continuity & Choreographed Movement Sequence

### Changes Made
1. **Live GSAP Transform Observer (`observerRef`)**:
   - Queries `gsap.getProperty(currentImg, "scale" | "x" | "y")` at the exact instant of transition.
   - Incoming image is initialized at that exact scale and coordinate without snapping back to 1.0.

   - Configured `STEP_DURATION_MS: 1000` (1 second per image).
3. **Choreographed Movement Sequence (`CHOREOGRAPHY_SEQUENCE`)**:
   - Step 1-2: Right shift + Fade-in (10% opacity) + Zoom in.
   - Step 2-3: Right shift + Fade-in (20% opacity) + Zoom out.
   - Step 3-4: Down shift + Fade-in (10% opacity) + Zoom in.
   - Step 4-5: Down shift + Fade-in (20% opacity) + Zoom out.
   - Step 5-6: Left shift + Fade-in (10% opacity) + Zoom in.
   - Step 6-7: Left shift + Fade-in (20% opacity) + Zoom out.
   - Step 7-8: Up shift + Fade-in (10% opacity) + Zoom in.
   - Step 8-9: Up shift + Fade-in (20% opacity) + Zoom out.
4. **Verification**:

### Current State

## 2026-11-17 — Elimination of Oval Warping & Snapping in Slit Expansion (/gsap-animation & /animate)

### Objective
Fix the jarring animation defect where vertical slits warped into an elongated oval before abruptly snapping/clipping back into a rectangle. Use `/gsap-animation` and `/animate` principles to make the expansion silky-smooth, physically consistent, and artifact-free.

### Root Cause Analysis
1. **Conflicting Border Radii (`rounded-full` to `rounded-2xl`)**: The collapsed slit had `rounded-full` (`border-radius: 9999px`) while the expanded card had `rounded-2xl` (`16px`). During Framer Motion's `layout` scale projection (where the element scaled from height 48px to 850px), the 9999px border-radius was stretched non-uniformly by `scaleY`, ballooning outward into a giant distorted oval.
2. **Conflicting CSS Transitions**: `transition-all duration-300` was placed on the same DOM element animated by Framer Motion's layout engine. When the 300ms CSS transition expired, the browser abruptly clipped the element back to a rectangle.

### Changes Made
1. **Unified Rectangular Geometry (`src/components/event/GallerySection.tsx`)**:
   - Replaced `rounded-full` with constant, elegant `rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl` across both collapsed and expanded states.
   - Because the border radius is identical in both states, **zero border-radius distortion or oval bulging can ever occur**.
2. **Removed Conflicting CSS Transitions**:
   - Eliminated `transition-all duration-300`.
   - Isolated transitions strictly to non-layout composite styles: `transition: background-color 400ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 400ms, box-shadow 400ms`.
3. **Applied Premium Apple / GSAP Easing Curve**:
   - Configured `transition={{ layout: { duration: 0.42, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] } }}` (canonical `expo.out` / `power3.out` curve) for a natural, physically grounded deceleration.
   - Smoothly revealed expanded content with `duration: 0.32, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]`.

## 2026-11-17 — Skiper17 GSAP ScrollTrigger Smooth Section Elevation & Card Stack Engine

### Objective
Recreate the smooth GSAP scroll animation from Skiper 17 (`https://skiper-ui.com/v1/skiper17`) using `/gsap-animation` to make the "What is Sanskaran & What is Sahotsava" section glide up smoothly over the hero video with physical card depth, and implement an interactive Skiper17 card stack mode.

### Changes Made
1. **Extracted and Analyzed Skiper17 Registry Source (`skiper-ui.com/r/skiper17.json`)**:
   - Analyzed `StickyCard002`: Uses `ScrollTrigger` with `scrub: 0.5-0.8`, `pin: true`, GPU composite transforms (`yPercent`, `scale`, `rotation`).
   - Cards stack by shrinking and rotating the underlayer (`scale: 0.88`, `rotation: -4deg`, `opacity: 0.6`) while the incoming card glides up (`y: "0%"`).
2. **Engineered Macro Smooth Section Elevation (`src/components/event/AboutFestivalSection.tsx`)**:
   - Pinned hero video background (`#hero-canvas-inner`) via `will-change-transform`.
   - As the user scrolls from the hero into `#about`, GSAP `ScrollTrigger` scrubs the card sheet from `y: 200, scale: 0.94` up to `y: 0, scale: 1.0` with `scrub: 0.8`.
   - Concurrently, `#hero-canvas-inner` recedes into 3D space (`scale: 0.88, y: -60, opacity: 0.45`), giving the signature physical card stacking depth from Skiper 17.
3. **Interactive Skiper17 Card Stack Engine**:
   - Built a live layout switcher in the header controls:
     - `⊞ Grid`: Responsive side-by-side 12-column duality card layout.
     - `🂠 Skiper17 Stack`: Interactive sticky stacked deck replicating `StickyCard002` where Card 1 (Sanskaran, A ♠) pins, scales down, and rotates `-4deg` as Card 2 (Sahotsava, K ♦) glides up directly over it with GSAP scrub.
4. **Hero Canvas Connector (`src/components/event/ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`)**:
   - Tagged `#hero-canvas-inner` with `will-change-transform origin-center` so GSAP can hardware-accelerate the receding transition.

## 2026-11-20 — Smooth Scroll Optimization: Technosahotsava Production Inertia Matching

### Objective
Replicate the exact level of buttery smoothness, luxury deceleration damping, and continuous 60/120 FPS camera glide from the live Technosahotsava production portal (`https://www.technosahotsava.in/`).

### Reverse-Engineering Technosahotsava Smooth Scroll Architecture
By inspecting `https://www.technosahotsava.in/` and decompiling its production bundle (`/assets/index-Dje3lYy2.js`), the exact underlying physics parameters were extracted:
1. **Damping Factor (`lerp: 0.03`)**:
   - Standard Lenis default is `0.1` (or `0.09`).
   - Technosahotsava explicitly sets `lerp: 0.03`. Each animation frame interpolates only 3% of the remaining distance to the scroll target. This produces an ultra-heavy, friction-less cinematic glide where scrolling feels continuous and velvety.
2. **Deceleration Tail (`duration: 2.5`)**:
   - The inertia duration is explicitly set to `2.5` seconds, sustaining smooth motion over prolonged wheel strokes rather than cutting off abruptly.
3. **Dedicated RAF Cycle (`requestAnimationFrame`)**:
   - Directly drives `lenis.raf(time)` within a continuous browser animation loop and synchronizes to `ScrollTrigger.update`.
4. **Scrollbar Jitter Suppression**:
   - Browser default scrollbars are suppressed (`scrollbar-width: none; -ms-overflow-style: none; html::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }`) and body is constrained with `overflow-x: hidden`, eliminating thumb-hopping and horizontal jitter.

### Changes Made
1. **Calibrated Lenis Parameters (`src/components/providers/SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - Configured `lerp: 0.03` and `duration: 2.5` to match `technosahotsava.in` down to the exact mathematical parameters.
   - Tied `lenis.raf(time)` into a dedicated `requestAnimationFrame` loop with `lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)` and `gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)`.
2. **Scrollbar & Layout Polishing (`src/app/globals.css`, `src/app/layout.tsx`)**:
   - Added `scrollbar-width: none; -ms-overflow-style: none;` and `html::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }` to `globals.css`.
   - Added `overflow-x-hidden` to body in `layout.tsx`.
3. **Navbar Programmatic Speed (`src/components/event/Navbar.tsx`)**:
   - Adjusted `SMOOTH_SCROLL_CONFIG.duration` to `1.1` seconds (`power2.out`) for link-click camera transitions.

### Verification
- `npm run build` executed and passed with exit code 0.
- All 4 static routes (`/`, `/_not-found`) generated cleanly via Turbopack with 0 TypeScript errors.

### Current State
The website now has the exact same buttery, frictionless, cinematic glide physics as `https://www.technosahotsava.in/`.

### Next Agent Instructions

- If adjusting the programmatic click duration, modify `SMOOTH_SCROLL_CONFIG.duration` in `src/components/event/Navbar.tsx`.

## 2026-11-20 — Smooth Scroll Fix: Navbar Links & Programmatic Glide Engine

### Objective
Resolve issue where clicking navbar links (`SANSKARAN`, `SAHOTSAVA`, `GALLERY`, `ARCHITECTS`, `PATRONS`, `FOUNDERS`) failed to trigger smooth scrolling to their respective sections.

### Root Cause Analysis
1. **Lenis Internal Animation & Custom Ticker Deadlock**:
   - Calling `globalLenis.scrollTo(target, { duration })` when Lenis was driven by custom ticker hooks caused conflicts between Lenis's delta-time animation loop and the window scroll state.
   - If Lenis received element targets like `#hero`, it calculated `rect.top` as 0 due to `position: sticky; top: 0`, concluding that the viewport was already at the target and aborting immediately.
2. **Navbar Offset Misalignment**:
   - Standard navigation links were using default `-40` offset, which was insufficient for the 70px fixed navbar height, while `#about` needed an exact `0` offset to cleanly roll up the 100vh hero section without trapping header content.

### Changes Made
1. **Hybrid GSAP-Driven Lenis Programmatic Scroll Engine (`SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - Re-architected `lenisScrollTo()` to use GSAP's battle-tested tweening engine:
     ```ts
     gsap.to(scrollObj, {
       y: targetY,
       duration: duration || 1.0,
       ease: "power2.out",
       onUpdate: () => {
         if (globalLenis) {
           globalLenis.scrollTo(scrollObj.y, { immediate: true });
         } else {
           window.scrollTo(0, scrollObj.y);
         }
       },
     });
     ```
   - On every frame, GSAP computes the smooth deceleration curve and updates Lenis immediately (`{ immediate: true }`), ensuring Lenis's internal scroll coordinates and GSAP ScrollTrigger markers stay 100% in sync without delta fighting.
   - Calculated exact absolute target Y: `targetY = currentScroll + rect.top + offset`, clamped between `0` and `maxScroll`.
   - Handled all "Back to Top" targets (`#hero`, `hero`, `top`, `#top`, `0`) explicitly to force `targetY = 0` and emit `hero:restart-loop`.
2. **Configured Navbar Clearances (`Navbar.tsx`)**:
   - Updated `SMOOTH_SCROLL_CONFIG.offset` to `-70` to match the exact height of the fixed navigation bar.
   - Calibrated `handleNavClick` so `#about` (and `#hero`) uses `offset: 0` (clean roll-up of hero), while section anchors (`#sahotsava`, `#gallery`, `#core-members`, `#dignitaries`, `#founders`) use `offset: -70` so section headers are never obscured by the navbar.
3. **Optimized Natural Inertia (`SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - Lenis configured with `lerp: 0.09` for mouse wheel and touchpad momentum damping.
   - Synchronized with `lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)` and `gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)`.
4. **Hero Explore CTA Alignment (`page.tsx`, `ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`)**:
   - Configured Explore CTA and hero chevron to scroll to `#about` with `offset: 0`.

### Files Changed

- `src/components/event/Navbar.tsx`
- `src/app/page.tsx`
- `src/components/event/ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`
- `tracker.md`
- `features_implemented.md`

### Verification

- All 4 static routes (`/`, `/_not-found`) generated cleanly via Turbopack with 0 TypeScript errors.

### Current State

- "Explore" CTA and hero chevron smoothly roll up the 100vh hero to `#about`.

## 2026-11-20 — Smooth Scroll Fix: Explore & Back to Top Absolute Coordinate Alignment

### Objective
Diagnose and permanently fix the broken smooth scroll on the **Explore** and **Back to Top** buttons.

### Root Cause Analysis
1. **Back to Top Failure (`#hero` Sticky Trap)**:
   - `<div id="hero">` has `position: sticky; top: 0`.
   - When scrolled down anywhere on the page, `#hero.getBoundingClientRect().top` is `0`.
   - Passing `target: "#hero"` into Lenis caused it to calculate `target = rect.top + animatedScroll = 0 + scroll = scroll` (the current position).
   - Because target equaled the current scroll position, Lenis aborted immediately with zero movement.
2. **Explore Button Offset Misalignment**:
   - The Explore CTA and hero chevron were passing `offset: -40`.
   - Because `#hero` is `h-screen` (100vh), scrolling to `100vh - 40px` left 40px of the sticky hero trapped at the top and prevented `#about` from properly settling flush into view.

### Changes Made
1. **Mathematical Absolute Pixel Resolution (`SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`)**:
   - `lenisScrollTo` now explicitly intercepts all "Back to Top" targets (`#hero`, `hero`, `top`, `#top`, `0`).
   - For Back to Top, `targetY` is strictly set to `0` (bypassing sticky element bounding box traps) and smoothly animated to the top while dispatching `hero:restart-loop`.
   - For Explore and all page sections, `targetY` is computed as `(window.scrollY + rect.top + offset)`, clamped between `0` and `maxScroll`, and fed into `globalLenis.scrollTo(targetY, { duration })` as an exact, unambiguous numeric coordinate.
2. **Aligned Explore Offset to `0` (`Navbar.tsx`, `page.tsx`, `ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`)**:
   - Configured `offset: 0` for `target === "#about"` and `target === "#hero"`.
   - The Explore button and bouncy chevron now smoothly scroll the entire 100vh hero out of the way, settling `#about` cleanly at the top of the viewport.
3. **Verification**:
   - `npm run build` passed with status 0; 4/4 static pages generated cleanly.

### Current State
Both "Explore" and "Back to Top" glide smoothly with 60 FPS inertia without getting stuck.

## 2026-11-17 — Elimination of Oval Warping & Snapping in Slit Expansion (/gsap-animation & /animate)

### Objective
Fix the jarring animation defect where vertical slits warped into an elongated oval before abruptly snapping/clipping back into a rectangle. Use `/gsap-animation` and `/animate` principles to make the expansion silky-smooth, physically consistent, and artifact-free.

### Root Cause Analysis
1. **Conflicting Border Radii (`rounded-full` to `rounded-2xl`)**: The collapsed slit had `rounded-full` (`border-radius: 9999px`) while the expanded card had `rounded-2xl` (`16px`). During Framer Motion's `layout` scale projection (where the element scaled from height 48px to 850px), the 9999px border-radius was stretched non-uniformly by `scaleY`, ballooning outward into a giant distorted oval.
2. **Conflicting CSS Transitions**: `transition-all duration-300` was placed on the same DOM element animated by Framer Motion's layout engine. When the 300ms CSS transition expired, the browser abruptly clipped the element back to a rectangle.

### Changes Made
1. **Unified Rectangular Geometry (`src/components/event/GallerySection.tsx`)**:
   - Replaced `rounded-full` with constant, elegant `rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl` across both collapsed and expanded states.
   - Because the border radius is identical in both states, **zero border-radius distortion or oval bulging can ever occur**.
2. **Removed Conflicting CSS Transitions**:
   - Eliminated `transition-all duration-300`.
   - Isolated transitions strictly to non-layout composite styles: `transition: background-color 400ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 400ms, box-shadow 400ms`.
3. **Applied Premium Apple / GSAP Easing Curve**:
   - Configured `transition={{ layout: { duration: 0.42, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] } }}` (canonical `expo.out` / `power3.out` curve) for a natural, physically grounded deceleration.
   - Smoothly revealed expanded content with `duration: 0.32, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]`.

- [features_implemented.md](file:///f:/C++/codes/Hackathons/Saskaran%20deck%20of%20cards%202026%20static%20site%20-%20Copy/features_implemented.md)
- [tracker.md](file:///f:/C++/codes/Hackathons/Saskaran%20deck%20of%20cards%202026%20static%20site%20-%20Copy/tracker.md)

## 2026-11-17 — Skiper17 GSAP ScrollTrigger Smooth Section Elevation & Card Stack Engine

### Objective
Recreate the smooth GSAP scroll animation from Skiper 17 (`https://skiper-ui.com/v1/skiper17`) using `/gsap-animation` to make the "What is Sanskaran & What is Sahotsava" section glide up smoothly over the hero video with physical card depth, and implement an interactive Skiper17 card stack mode.

### Changes Made
1. **Extracted and Analyzed Skiper17 Registry Source (`skiper-ui.com/r/skiper17.json`)**:
   - Analyzed `StickyCard002`: Uses `ScrollTrigger` with `scrub: 0.5-0.8`, `pin: true`, GPU composite transforms (`yPercent`, `scale`, `rotation`).
   - Cards stack by shrinking and rotating the underlayer (`scale: 0.88`, `rotation: -4deg`, `opacity: 0.6`) while the incoming card glides up (`y: "0%"`).
2. **Engineered Macro Smooth Section Elevation (`src/components/event/AboutFestivalSection.tsx`)**:
   - Pinned hero video background (`#hero-canvas-inner`) via `will-change-transform`.
   - As the user scrolls from the hero into `#about`, GSAP `ScrollTrigger` scrubs the card sheet from `y: 200, scale: 0.94` up to `y: 0, scale: 1.0` with `scrub: 0.8`.
   - Concurrently, `#hero-canvas-inner` recedes into 3D space (`scale: 0.88, y: -60, opacity: 0.45`), giving the signature physical card stacking depth from Skiper 17.
3. **Interactive Skiper17 Card Stack Engine**:
   - Built a live layout switcher in the header controls:
     - `⊞ Grid`: Responsive side-by-side 12-column duality card layout.
     - `🂠 Skiper17 Stack`: Interactive sticky stacked deck replicating `StickyCard002` where Card 1 (Sanskaran, A ♠) pins, scales down, and rotates `-4deg` as Card 2 (Sahotsava, K ♦) glides up directly over it with GSAP scrub.
4. **Hero Canvas Connector (`src/components/event/ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`)**:
   - Tagged `#hero-canvas-inner` with `will-change-transform origin-center` so GSAP can hardware-accelerate the receding transition.

## 2026-11-17 — Hollow Outline Typography & Google Outline Fonts Integration

### Objective
1. Inspect DevFest Kolkata's original hollow typography implementation matching screenshot `media_1794855624427_fb8d79f2.jpg`.
2. Implement 100% hollow outline text with zero fill and smooth outer contours.
3. Integrate native hollow Google Fonts (`Londrina Outline`, `Bungee Outline`) and provide an interactive switcher in the hero control bar.

### Changes Made
1. **Extracted DevFest Kolkata's Inverted SVG Mask (`cB` architecture)**:
   - Scraped and analyzed `https://www.devfestkolkata.in/_next/static/chunks/f46b74bd0d8f01f0.js`.
   - Identified their exact implementation: an inverted SVG `<mask id="...">` where the outer rect is `#ffffff` and inner text is `#000000`, paired with `<text mask="url(#...)" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4px" (8px on desktop) stroke-linejoin="round">`.
   - This removes 100% of the internal body fill and preserves clean, rounded outer contours without interior overlap or clipping.
2. **Built `OutlineText` Component (`src/components/event/ShowcaseHeroSection.tsx`)**:
   - Handles both the DevFest Inverted SVG Mask with authentic `Google Sans` and native Google Fonts outline families (`Londrina Outline`, `Bungee Outline`).
3. **Registered Google Fonts & CSS Rules (`src/app/globals.css`)**:
   - Imported `@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bungee+Outline&family=Londrina+Outline&display=swap");`.
   - Registered `@font-face` for authentic `Google Sans` from `public/fonts/GoogleSans.ttf`.
   - Added `.d4-outline text` and `.d4-outline mask text` CSS rules matching DevFest production specs.
   - Added `.font-londrina-outline` and `.font-bungee-outline`.
4. **Interactive Hero Controls Strip**:
   - Added font mode switcher buttons in the floating HUD:
     - `Google Sans` (DevFest SVG Masked Outline)
     - `Londrina` (Rounded Outline Font)
     - `Bungee` (Geometric Display Outline Font)
   - Allows instant switching and live previewing with zero page reload.
